title: The People Who Wear Their Stories

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: Admiring a villager's tattoos, a child asks whether distant people might mark their skin with stories too.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Admiring a villager's tattoos, (name1), a child, asks whether distant people might mark their skin with stories too.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The tattoo artist imagines distant artists drawing family histories on skin.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A scholar warns that markings in one land might mean something entirely different elsewhere.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A child imagines people with completely bare skin and finds it hard to picture.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A villager without tattoos points out that plenty of Isolans have none, and that is fine.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Several villagers share the stories behind their markings, and the evening becomes a storytelling circle.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: One villager prefers to keep the story of their markings private, and the others respect it.
